units.title: 喜合婚姻，世应宜静，财官旺相可成：男娶看财、女嫁看鬼，世夫应妇；占夫忌子孙动，占妻忌兄弟动；间爻为媒

rule.yi: 婚姻喜欢卦相合，世爻、应爻宜静，财爻、官爻旺相，婚姻就可以成。世应有动就不成。男家娶妻看财爻（代人占也一样），女家嫁丈夫用官鬼爻；用神忌讳动，出现时怕被冲；旺相可成，世应互相克则不长久。世爻代表丈夫，应爻代表妻子。还要看是谁占：占丈夫忌子孙爻发动，子孙持世就不成；占妻子忌兄弟爻发动，兄弟持世就不成。间爻是媒人，父母爻是三堂，子孙爻是子嗣，都宜静。卦里没有子孙爻，不欢喜。
rule.en: A marriage likes a hexagram that combines; the Self and Other lines should be still, and with Wealth and Pressure strong the marriage can be made. If the Self or Other line moves, it will not succeed. When the man's family takes a wife look at the Wealth line (the same for a divination on someone's behalf); when the woman's family marries her to a husband use the Pressure line. The Subject fears moving, and when it appears it fears being clashed; if strong it can be made, but if the Self and Other control each other it will not last. The Self line is the husband and the Other line the wife. Look also at who is divining: for a husband, fear a moving Output line, and an Output line on the Self means it will not succeed; for a wife, fear a moving Peer line, and a Peer line on the Self means it will not succeed. The between lines are the go-between, the Resource line is the 'three halls', the Output line is the heir; all should be still. A hexagram without an Output line is not a happy one.

zh: 喜合婚姻，世应宜静；
财官旺相，婚姻可成。
世应有动便不成，男家娶妻看财爻，代占同。
女家嫁夫用鬼爻。
忌动出现，怕冲，若旺相可成，世应相克不久。
世夫应妇。
又看何人占之，占夫忌子孙发动，子孙持世不成，占妻忌兄弟发动，兄弟持世不成。
间爻为媒，父母为三堂，子孙为嗣，宜静。
卦无子孙不欢喜。
yi: 婚姻喜欢卦相合，世爻应爻宜安静；
财爻、官爻旺相，婚姻可以成。
世应有动，就不成；男家娶妻看财爻，代人占也一样。
女家嫁丈夫用官鬼爻。
（用神）忌讳动，出现时怕被冲；如果旺相可以成，世应相克则不长久。
世爻代表丈夫，应爻代表妻子。
还要看是谁占的：占丈夫忌子孙爻发动，子孙持世不成；占妻子忌兄弟爻发动，兄弟持世不成。
间爻是媒人，父母爻是三堂，子孙爻是子嗣，都宜安静。
卦里没有子孙爻，不欢喜。
en: A marriage likes a hexagram that combines, and the Self and Other lines should be still;
with Wealth and Pressure strong, the marriage can be made.
If the Self or Other line moves it will not succeed; when the man's family takes a wife, look at the Wealth line, and it is the same for a divination on someone's behalf.
When the woman's family marries her to a husband, use the Pressure line.
The Subject fears moving, and when it appears it fears being clashed; if it is strong it can be made, but if the Self and Other control each other it will not last.
The Self line is the husband and the Other line the wife.

Look also at who is divining: for a husband, fear a moving Output line, and an Output line on the Self means it will not succeed; for a wife, fear a moving Peer line, and a Peer line on the Self means it will not succeed.
The between lines are the go-between, the Resource line is the 'three halls', the Output line is the heir; all should be still.
A hexagram without an Output line is not a happy one.

note.yi: 开头的小标题「占婚姻」和第一句连在一起，这里从「喜合婚姻」起引。「三堂」在下一条问答里有解释（父母、兄弟、子孙三种爻）。
note.en: The heading 'divining marriage' runs into the first sentence in the text, so the quotation starts at 'a marriage likes a hexagram that combines'. The 'three halls' are explained in the question-and-answer in the next unit (the Resource, Peer and Output lines).

units.title: 世应有动便不成：世动男家进退，应动女家不肯，空亦然；所忌是财官两爻动；三堂是父母、兄弟、子孙

rule.yi: 为什么世应一动就不成？世爻动，男家进退不定；应爻动，女家不肯；世应逢空也一样。所忌的「二字动」，忌的是财、官两个爻动。「三堂」是父母、兄弟、子孙三种爻。
rule.en: Why does it fail if the Self or Other line moves? If the Self line moves, the man's family wavers; if the Other line moves, the woman's family will not agree; the same if the Self or Other line is Void. The 'two' whose moving is feared are the Wealth and Pressure lines. The 'three halls' are the Resource, Peer and Output lines.

zh: 或问：世应有动便不成何也？
答曰：世动男家进退，应动女家不肯，世应有空亦然。
问：忌二字动，忌何爻动也？
曰：财官二字。
何为三堂？
父母、兄弟、子孙也。
yi: 有人问：世应有动为什么就不成？
答：世爻动，男家进退不定；应爻动，女家不肯；世应有空也是这样。
问：忌讳「二字」动，是忌讳哪个爻动？
答：就是财、官这两个字（爻）。
什么是三堂？
就是父母爻、兄弟爻、子孙爻。
en: Someone asks: why does it fail if the Self or Other line moves?
The answer: if the Self line moves, the man's family wavers; if the Other line moves, the woman's family will not agree; the same if the Self or Other line is Void.
Asked: it fears the 'two' moving; which lines' moving is feared?
The answer: the two words 'Wealth' and 'Pressure'.
What are the 'three halls'?
They are the Resource, Peer and Output lines.

units.title: 财爻合兄弟妇不廉，五爻持鬼妇貌丑；财伏墓下生离死别，财伏鬼下妇带疾，财伏兄下妇淫荡，鬼伏兄下男赌博，身爻值鬼带暗疾

rule.yi: 看对方的品行、相貌和健康：财爻与兄弟爻相合，这个妇人不守妇道；第五爻持鬼爻，妇人相貌丑；财爻伏在墓爻下面，主生离死别；财爻伏在鬼爻下面，主妇人带病（兄弟爻伏在鬼爻下面也一样）；财爻伏在兄弟爻下面，主妇人淫荡；鬼爻伏在兄弟爻下面，主男子好赌博；身爻是鬼爻，主带暗病。
rule.en: Reading the other party's conduct, looks and health: when the Wealth line combines with a Peer line, the woman is not chaste; with Pressure on the fifth line, she is ugly; Wealth hidden beneath a tomb line means parting alive or by death; Wealth hidden beneath Pressure means the woman carries an illness (a Peer line hidden beneath Pressure is the same); Wealth hidden beneath a Peer line means she is licentious; Pressure hidden beneath a Peer line means the man gambles; if the Body line is Pressure, there is a hidden illness.

zh: 凡财爻与兄弟合，此妇不廉；
五爻持鬼，此妇貌丑；
财伏墓下，主生离死别；
财伏鬼下，主妇人带疾，兄伏鬼亦然。
财伏兄下，主妇人淫荡；
鬼伏兄下，主男子赌博；
身爻值鬼，主带暗疾，此又不传之妙。
yi: 凡是财爻与兄弟爻相合，这个妇人不守妇道；
第五爻持鬼爻，这个妇人相貌丑；
财爻伏在墓爻下面，主生离死别；
财爻伏在鬼爻下面，主妇人带病，兄弟爻伏在鬼爻下面也一样。
财爻伏在兄弟爻下面，主妇人淫荡；
鬼爻伏在兄弟爻下面，主男子好赌博；
身爻是鬼爻，主带暗病，这又是不外传的诀窍。
en: When the Wealth line combines with a Peer line, this woman is not chaste;
with Pressure on the fifth line, this woman is ugly;
Wealth hidden beneath a tomb line means parting alive or by death;
Wealth hidden beneath Pressure means the woman carries an illness, and a Peer line hidden beneath Pressure is the same.
Wealth hidden beneath a Peer line means the woman is licentious;
Pressure hidden beneath a Peer line means the man gambles;
If the Body line is Pressure, there is a hidden illness; this is one more unpublished secret.

note.yi: 「廉」在这里指妇人操守，译作「不守妇道」是按上下文取的，没有别处可对。
note.en: 'Lian' (integrity) is applied here to a woman's conduct; 'not chaste' is taken from the context, with no other text to check it against.

units.title: 占妻看财爻、占夫看官爻，都宜静；阳宫端正阴宫丑陋；男占得震巽主再婚，女占得坎离主再嫁

rule.yi: 占妻子看财爻，占丈夫看官鬼爻，都宜安静。阳宫的人端正，阴宫的人丑陋：落在飞神上，应在头面四肢；落在伏神下，应在笨拙、不稳当。男子占得震卦、巽卦，主再婚；女子占得坎卦、离卦，主再嫁。
rule.en: For a wife look at the Wealth line and for a husband at the Pressure line; both should be still. A yang palace means upright looks and a yin palace ugly ones: on the flying spirit it answers in the head, face and limbs, and under it, in clumsiness and unsteadiness. A man who gets Zhen or Xun will marry again; a woman who gets Kan or Li will marry again.

zh: 占妻看财爻，宜静；
占夫看官爻，宜静。
阳宫端正、阴宫丑陋，在飞上应头面四肢，在飞下应拙不稳。
男占得震巽主再婚；
女占得坎离主再嫁。
yi: 占妻子看财爻，宜安静；
占丈夫看官爻，宜安静。
阳宫端正，阴宫丑陋，落在飞神上应在头面四肢，落在飞神下应在笨拙、不稳当。
男子占，得震卦、巽卦，主再婚；
女子占，得坎卦、离卦，主再嫁。
en: For a wife look at the Wealth line, which should be still;
for a husband look at the Pressure line, which should be still.
A yang palace means upright looks, a yin palace ugly ones; on the flying spirit it answers in the head, face and limbs, and under the flying spirit, in clumsiness and unsteadiness.
A man who gets Zhen or Xun will marry again;
a woman who gets Kan or Li will marry again.

note.yi: 「飞上」「飞下」里的「飞」指飞神（卦上现出的爻），「下」指它下面伏着的伏神；译文按这个读法，原文只有这三个字。
note.en: In 'on the flying' and 'under the flying', 'flying' means the flying spirit (the line shown in the hexagram), and 'under' its hidden spirit; the translation follows this reading, and the original has nothing more to check it against.

units.title: 妻在间爻由女方亲人主婚，夫在间爻由男方亲人主婚，得时旺相皆许成；出现忌日冲，世动男不肯，应动女生疑；用神动成也分离；间动有阻隔

rule.yi: 妻子（财爻）在间爻上，女方有亲人做主婚人；丈夫（官鬼爻）在间爻上，男方有亲人做主婚人；只要得时旺相，都许可成。用神出现时怕被日辰冲；世爻动，男方不肯；应爻动，女方起疑。用神如果发动，即使成了也会分离。间爻动有阻隔，或者是媒人化作鬼爻；如果占的是女子的美丑，另看下一条。
rule.en: If the wife (Wealth) is on a between line, a relative of the woman's side presides at the marriage; if the husband (Pressure) is on a between line, a relative of the man's side presides; so long as it is in season and strong, all may be made. The Subject, when it appears, fears being clashed by the Day; if the Self line moves the man will not agree, if the Other line moves the woman grows doubtful. If the Subject moves, even if made it ends in separation. A moving between line means obstruction, or the go-between turning into Pressure; if the question is the woman's looks, see the next unit.

zh: 妻在间爻，女有亲为主婚；
夫在间爻、男有亲为主婚，但得时旺相，皆许成。
出现忌日冲，世动，男不肯，应动，女生疑。
用神如发动，成也见分离。
间动有阻隔，或是媒人作鬼，如占女人妍丑。
yi: 妻子在间爻，女方有亲人做主婚人；
丈夫在间爻，男方有亲人做主婚人，只要得时旺相，都许可成。
用神出现时怕被日辰冲，世爻动，男方不肯，应爻动，女方起疑。
用神如果发动，成了也见分离。
间爻动有阻隔，或者是媒人化作鬼爻，如占女人妍丑。
en: If the wife is on a between line, a relative of the woman's side presides at the marriage;
if the husband is on a between line, a relative of the man's side presides; so long as it is in season and strong, all may be made.
The Subject, when it appears, fears being clashed by the Day; if the Self line moves the man will not agree, if the Other line moves the woman grows doubtful.
If the Subject moves, even if made it ends in separation.
A moving between line means obstruction, or the go-between turning into Pressure; as when divining whether the woman is fair or ugly.

note.yi: 最后一句「如占女人妍丑」接着是下一条讲相貌的话，和前面阻隔的话并不相连；这里跟着原文标点一并收进。
note.en: The last clause 'as when divining whether the woman is fair or ugly' leads into the following talk of looks and is not connected to the talk of obstruction before it; it is taken in together with the original punctuation.

units.title: 第五爻为面部，财福旺相持之绝色，父母次之，兄弟持之貌丑；上六爻为头发，火坐之发焦黄；看脚专看初爻

rule.yi: 看女子的相貌：第五爻是面部，财爻、福德（子孙）爻旺相而持在这里，是绝色；父母爻次之；兄弟爻持在这里，相貌丑陋不好看。上六爻是头发，如果火爻坐在这里，主鬓发焦黄。看脚大小专看初爻：初爻是阳，主大脚；初爻是阴，主小脚（缠足）；重爻变化的拆开一半缠；交爻变化的先缠后放。
rule.en: Reading the woman's looks: the fifth line is the face; if a strong Wealth or Output line holds it, she is a rare beauty; the Resource line comes next; a Peer line holding it means an ugly, unlovely face. The top line is the hair; if a Fire line sits there, the hair is scorched yellow. To see whether the feet are large or small look only at the first line: a yang first line means large feet, a yin first line small feet (bound feet); a doubled line that changes is half-bound, and a crossed line that changes is bound first and released later.

zh: 第五爻为面部，如财福旺相持之，绝色。
父母次之，兄弟持之，貌丑陋不妍。
上六爻为头发，如火坐之，主鬓发焦黄色。
看大脚小脚，专看初爻，初爻是阳，主大脚，初爻是阴，主小脚，重化拆半扎脚。
交化单先缠后放。
yi: 第五爻为面部，如果财爻、福德爻旺相持在这里，是绝色。
父母爻次之，兄弟爻持在这里，相貌丑陋不妍。
上六爻为头发，如果火爻坐在这里，主鬓发焦黄。
看大脚小脚，专看初爻，初爻是阳，主大脚，初爻是阴，主小脚，重爻变化的拆开一半缠。
交爻变化的先缠后放。
en: The fifth line is the face; if a strong Wealth or Output line holds it, she is a rare beauty.
The Resource line comes next; a Peer line holding it means an ugly, unlovely face.
The top line is the hair; if a Fire line sits there, the hair is scorched yellow.
To see whether the feet are large or small look only at the first line: a yang first line means large feet, a yin first line small feet; a doubled line that changes is half-bound.
A crossed line that changes is bound first and released later.

note.yi: 「扎脚」「缠」指旧时女子缠足，「重」「交」是掷钱起卦时老阳、老阴的旧称。原文把「重」和「交」写得很省，译文照字面，没有多解释。
note.en: 'Binding' refers to the old practice of foot-binding, and 'doubled' and 'crossed' are old names for the moving yang and moving yin lines in coin-casting. The text is terse; it is translated literally without further explanation.

units.title: 占婢妾专以财爻为主象：财旺吉；动出官主病讼、动出兄主口舌；兄爻合财主外情；财化子善、化官带疾、化兄淫荡、化父老成；定妇人女子看财福二爻

rule.yi: 占婢妾：专以财爻为主要的象。财爻旺相就吉；动出官鬼爻，主生病、招官司；动出兄弟爻，主口舌。兄弟爻和财爻相合而合住，主有不正当的外情。有别的爻和财爻三刑六害，一定因此打官司。财化子孙，性善；财化官鬼，带病；财化兄弟，淫荡不良；财化父母，老成；财化子孙，性情迟缓不管事。分辨是妇人还是女子：看财、福两个爻，生扶身、世而没有冲克的是女子；财福去生官鬼、兄弟，或者官鬼、兄弟旺而动的是妇人。
rule.en: Divining a maid or concubine: take the Wealth line alone as the chief sign. Strong Wealth is auspicious; a Pressure line moving out means illness and a lawsuit; a Peer line moving out means quarrels. If a Peer line and the Wealth line combine and hold each other, there is an improper outside attachment. If any line forms a three-punishment or six-harm with the Wealth line, a lawsuit will surely arise from it. Wealth changing into Output: good-natured; into Pressure: carries an illness; into a Peer line: licentious and of bad conduct; into Resource: mature and steady; into Output: slow by nature and takes no responsibility. To tell a married woman from a maiden, look at the Wealth and Output lines: if they generate the Body and Self lines with no clash or control, she is a maiden; if Wealth and Output generate Pressure or a Peer line, or Pressure or a Peer line is strong and moving, she is a married woman.

zh: 专以财爻为主象，财爻旺相便吉，若动出官来，主生病招讼，动出兄来，主口舌；
若兄爻财爻合住，主有外情不良。
如有爻象与财爻三刑六害，必主因此成讼；
财化子性善；
财化官带疾；
财化兄主淫荡不良；
财化父老成；
财化子，性迟缓不管事。
定妇人、女子，看财福二爻，生身世无冲克是女子，财福生官兄，或官兄旺动是妇人。
yi: 专以财爻为主要的象，财爻旺相便吉，如果动出官鬼爻来，主生病、招官司，动出兄弟爻来，主口舌；
如果兄弟爻和财爻相合而合住，主有不正当的外情。
如果有哪个爻和财爻三刑、六害，一定因此打官司；
财化成子孙，性情善良；
财化成官鬼，带病；
财化成兄弟，主淫荡不良；
财化成父母，老成稳重；
财化成子孙，性情迟缓、不管事。
要判断是妇人还是女子，看财、福两个爻：生扶身爻、世爻而没有冲克的是女子；财福去生官鬼、兄弟，或者官鬼、兄弟旺而动的是妇人。
en: Take the Wealth line alone as the chief sign; if the Wealth line is strong it is auspicious; if a Pressure line moves out, it means illness and a lawsuit, and if a Peer line moves out, quarrels;
if a Peer line and the Wealth line combine and hold each other, there is an improper outside attachment.
If any line forms a three-punishment or six-harm with the Wealth line, a lawsuit will surely arise from it;
Wealth changing into Output: good-natured;
into Pressure: carries an illness;
into a Peer line: licentious and of bad conduct;
into Resource: mature and steady;
into Output: slow by nature and takes no responsibility.

To tell a married woman from a maiden, look at the Wealth and Output lines: if they generate the Body and Self lines with no clash or control, she is a maiden; if Wealth and Output generate Pressure or a Peer line, or Pressure or a Peer line is strong and moving, she is a married woman.

note.yi: 「财化子」出现了两次，一次断「性善」，一次断「性迟缓不管事」，原文如此，没有替它改；第二处也许是别的爻之误，书里无从核对。小标题「附：占婢妾」和正文连在一起，这里从「专以财爻」起引。「妇人」「女子」在这里指已婚的和未嫁的，是按上下文取的。
note.en: 'Wealth changing into Output' appears twice, once judged 'good-natured' and once 'slow and takes no responsibility'. The text is left as it stands; the second may be a slip for another line, and there is nothing in the book to check it against. The heading 'Appendix: divining maids and concubines' runs into the first sentence, so the quotation starts at 'take the Wealth line alone'. 'Married woman' and 'maiden' are taken from the context.

units.title: 占雇取仆从亦用财爻：财不可太过也不可无财或空亡；子化财纯善、鬼化财带疾、兄化财不诚实、父化财稳重、财化兄淫荡；身爻是鬼有疾、是父识字、是兄说谎、是子慈善、是财最好

rule.yi: 雇用、聘取仆从，也以财爻为主要的象：财爻不能太过，也不能没有财爻或者落空亡，那样的仆人慵懒不上进。子孙化财，为人纯朴善良；鬼爻化财，带病；兄弟化财，不诚实，爱说谎、瞒骗别人；父母化财，性情稳重，做事稳当；财化兄弟，多淫荡，难以托付钱财。还要看身爻：身爻是鬼，主有病；是父母，主识字；是兄弟，多说谎；是子孙，主慈善；是财爻最好。如果化出鬼爻，主生病、招口舌；化出兄弟爻，主口舌、不稳当。
rule.en: For hiring or taking on a servant, too, take the Wealth line as the chief sign: it must be neither excessive nor absent or Void, or the servant is idle and unambitious. Output changing into Wealth: simple and kind; Pressure changing into Wealth: carries an illness; a Peer line changing into Wealth: dishonest, lies and cheats people; Resource changing into Wealth: steady in nature and reliable in work; Wealth changing into a Peer line: mostly licentious and cannot be trusted with money. Look also at the Body line: Pressure means illness, Resource means literacy, a Peer line means lying, Output means kindness and charity, and Wealth is best. If it changes out into Pressure, illness and quarrels; into a Peer line, quarrels and unreliability.

zh: 凡占雇取仆从亦用财爻为主象。
财不可太过，又不可无财并空亡，若如此，慵懒不向前。
子化财，为人纯善；
鬼化财、带疾；
兄化财不诚实，多说谎瞒骗人家；
父化财，性重作事稳，财化兄，多淫荡难托财。
又看身爻，身是鬼主有疾；
身是父，主识字；
身是兄，多说谎，身是子，主慈善。
身是财最好。
如化出鬼，主生病、招口舌；
化出兄，主口舌不稳。
yi: 凡是占雇用、聘取仆从，也用财爻为主要的象。
财爻不能太过，又不能没有财爻或者落空亡，如果这样，（仆人）慵懒、不上进。
子孙化成财爻，为人纯朴善良；
鬼爻化成财爻，带病；
兄弟爻化成财爻，不诚实，爱说谎、瞒骗别人；
父母爻化成财爻，性情稳重、做事稳当；财化成兄弟，多淫荡，难以托付钱财。
还要看身爻：身爻是鬼，主有病；
身爻是父母，主识字；
身爻是兄弟，多说谎；身爻是子孙，主慈善。
身爻是财最好。
如果化出鬼爻，主生病、招口舌；
化出兄弟爻，主口舌、不稳当。
en: For hiring a servant too, take the Wealth line as the chief sign.
Wealth must be neither excessive nor absent or Void; if it is so, the servant is idle and unambitious.
Output changing into Wealth: the person is simple and kind;
Pressure changing into Wealth: carries an illness;
a Peer line changing into Wealth: dishonest, often lies and cheats people;
Resource changing into Wealth: steady in nature and reliable in work; Wealth changing into a Peer line: mostly licentious and cannot be trusted with money.
Look also at the Body line: if the Body is Pressure, there is illness;
if the Body is Resource, the person is literate;
if the Body is a Peer line, he often lies; if the Body is Output, he is kind and charitable.
The Body being Wealth is best.
If it changes out into Pressure, illness and quarrels;
if it changes out into a Peer line, quarrels and unreliability.

note.yi: 这一节是「占婢妾」的接续，讲雇用仆从，和婚姻本身关系不大；收在这里是因为它在《火珠林》「占婚姻」这一条里。
note.en: This part continues 'divining maids and concubines' and deals with hiring servants, which has little to do with marriage itself; it is included because it stands in the Huozhulin's 'divining marriage' entry.

units.title: 内身阳鬼丈夫持，外应财阴总是妻：世应相生比和婚大吉；青龙六合扶、三合子孙临更奇；应动遇三刑、外交六害则害无疑

rule.yi: 内边（内卦、身）是阳、鬼爻是阳，丈夫就在这一边；外边（外卦、应）是阴、财爻是阴，总是妻子。世爻、应爻相生，婚姻大吉；世应比和，配成夫妻相宜。青龙、六合扶持就美，三合再加子孙爻临上更妙。应爻动而遇三刑，就是刑，不用再问；外卦交来六害，害是无疑的。
rule.en: With the inner side, the Body, yang and Pressure yang, the husband holds there; with the outer side, the Other line, yin and Wealth yin, that is always the wife. The Self and Other lines generating each other: the marriage is greatly auspicious; the Self and Other in accord, the pairing is fitting. Helped by the Azure Dragon and a Six-combine it is fair; a three-harmony with the Output line present is more wondrous still. If the Other line moves and meets a three-punishment, there is punishment, ask no further; if the outer side meets a six-harm, harm is beyond doubt.

zh: 内身阳鬼丈夫持，外应财阴总是妻。
世应相生婚大吉，比和世应配相宜。
青龙六合扶为美，三合子孙临更奇。
应动三刑刑莫问，外交六害害无疑。
yi: 内边（内卦、身）是阳，鬼爻是阳，丈夫就在这一边；外边（外卦、应）是阴，财爻是阴，总是妻子。
世爻应爻相生，婚姻大吉；世应比和，配成夫妻相宜。
青龙、六合扶持就美，三合再加子孙爻临上更妙。
应爻动而遇三刑，就是刑，不用再问；外卦交来六害，害是无疑的。
en: With the inner side, the Body, yang and Pressure yang, the husband holds there; with the outer side, the Other line, yin and Wealth yin, that is always the wife.
The Self and Other lines generating each other: the marriage is greatly auspicious; the Self and Other in accord, the pairing is fitting.
Helped by the Azure Dragon and a Six-combine it is fair; a three-harmony with the Output line present is more wondrous still.
If the Other line moves and meets a three-punishment, there is punishment, ask no further; if the outer side meets a six-harm, harm is beyond doubt.

note.yi: 「内身」「外应」的确切所指原文没有交代：可以读作内卦与身一边、外卦与应一边（译文取这个读法），也可以读作别的分法。同样的阴阳配法见《黄金策》第一条。
note.en: The text does not say exactly what 'inner Body' and 'outer Other' mean: they can be read as the inner trigram with the Body side and the outer trigram with the Other side (the reading taken here), or divided some other way. The same yin-yang pairing is in the first unit of the Huangjin Ce.

units.title: 三爻并偶生成少，六位纯阳养育稀

rule.yi: 三个爻并排全是偶（阴），生下的子女少；六个位置全是纯阳，养育的子女稀少。
rule.en: Three lines side by side all even (yin): few children are born; all six places pure yang: children are seldom raised.

zh: 三爻并偶生成少，六位纯阳养育稀。
yi: 三个爻都是偶（阴），生成的子女少；六个位置全是纯阳，养育的子女稀少。
en: Three lines all even (yin): few children are born; six places all pure yang: children are seldom raised.

units.title: 男女合同咸泰益，夫妻反目革睽离：夬宫阳壮妻难保，姤卦阴强家不齐；「不有躬」在蒙里断，「夫征不复」在渐中推

rule.yi: 男女同心合意，是咸、泰、益这些卦；夫妻反目，是革、睽、离这些卦。夬卦一宫阳气壮盛，妻子难保；姤卦阴气强，家里不齐整。「不有躬」到蒙卦里去判断，「夫征不复」到渐卦里去推算。
rule.en: Man and woman in agreement: hexagrams like Xian, Tai and Yi; husband and wife falling out: Ge, Kui and Li. In the palace of Guai, yang is strong and the wife is hard to keep; in the hexagram Gou, yin is strong and the household is not whole. 'Not to have a body' is judged in Meng; 'the husband goes on the expedition and does not return' is reckoned in Jian.

zh: 男女合同咸泰益，夫妻反目革睽离。
夬宫阳壮妻难保，姤卦阴强家不齐。
不有其躬蒙里断，夫征不复渐中推。
yi: 男女同心合意，是咸、泰、益这些卦；夫妻反目，是革、睽、离这些卦。
夬卦一宫阳气壮盛，妻子难保；姤卦阴气强，家里不齐整。
「不有躬」到蒙卦里去判断，「夫征不复」到渐卦里去推算。
en: Man and woman in agreement: hexagrams like Xian, Tai and Yi; husband and wife falling out: Ge, Kui and Li.
In the palace of Guai, yang is strong and the wife is hard to keep; in the hexagram Gou, yin is strong and the household is not whole.
'Not to have a body' is judged in Meng; 'the husband goes on the expedition and does not return' is reckoned in Jian.

note.yi: 最后一联是《周易》爻辞：蒙卦六三「勿用取女，见金夫，不有躬」，渐卦九三「夫征不复，妇孕不育」。这是按卦名断的口诀，和《增删卜易》觉子反对拿卦名断婚的那一条（LY.MARRY.ZS.14）正好相反的一边。
note.en: The last couplet quotes the line texts of the Book of Changes: Meng, third line, 'do not take this woman; she sees a man of gold and does not keep herself', and Jian, third line, 'the husband goes on the expedition and does not return; the wife conceives but does not bear'. This is judging by the names of hexagrams, the opposite side from Juezi's argument against it in LY.MARRY.ZS.14.

units.title: 一奇一偶成亲顺，双鬼双财匹配违；杀遇妻财妻子厄，杀临官鬼丈夫哀

rule.yi: 一阳一阴（一奇一偶），成亲顺利；两个鬼爻、两个财爻，婚配违逆不合。凶煞遇到妻财，妻子有厄；凶煞临到官鬼，丈夫悲哀（有灾）。
rule.en: One odd and one even: the match goes smoothly; two Pressure lines or two Wealth lines: the pairing goes against. A baleful star meeting the Wealth line brings the wife distress; a baleful star on the Pressure line brings the husband sorrow.

zh: 一奇一偶成亲顺，双鬼双财匹配违。
杀遇妻财妻子厄，杀临官鬼丈夫哀。
yi: 一奇一偶，成亲顺利；两个鬼爻、两个财爻，婚配违逆不合。
凶煞遇到妻财，妻子有厄；凶煞临到官鬼，丈夫悲哀。
en: One odd and one even: the match goes smoothly; two Pressure lines or two Wealth lines: the pairing goes against.
A baleful star meeting the Wealth line brings the wife distress; a baleful star on the Pressure line brings the husband sorrow.

units.title: 妻财官鬼青龙助则富贵男儿福德妻；官鬼两重相克应，女人曾许两家

rule.yi: 妻财、官鬼有青龙相助，是富贵男子，妻子有福德（子孙）。官鬼有两重，互相克应爻，这个女子曾经许过两家。
rule.en: Wealth and Pressure helped by the Azure Dragon: a man of wealth and rank, with a wife of Output, the fortune-and-virtue line. Two layers of Pressure, controlling the Other line: the woman was once promised to two families.

zh: 妻财官鬼青龙助，富贵男儿福德妻。
官鬼两重相克应，女人曾许两家期。
yi: 妻财、官鬼有青龙相助，是富贵男子，娶的是有福德（子孙爻）的妻子。
官鬼有两重、互相克应爻，这个女子曾经许过两家。
en: Wealth and Pressure helped by the Azure Dragon: a man of wealth and rank, with a wife of Output (fortune and virtue).
Two layers of Pressure, controlling the Other line: the woman was once promised to two families.

units.title: 白虎临财莫问婚，勾陈加官克夫身；杀临兄弟多争竞，朱雀临身公讼因；勾陈阴杀休求女，玄武加财休问亲

rule.yi: 白虎临在财爻上，不要问婚事；勾陈加在官鬼位上，克夫身。凶煞临在兄弟爻上，多有争执；朱雀临身（爻），因官司而起。勾陈带阴煞，不要求女方；玄武加在财爻上，不要问亲事。
rule.en: The White Tiger on the Wealth line: do not ask about the marriage; Hook Earth added to the Pressure position controls the husband's person. A baleful star on a Peer line: many quarrels; the Vermilion Bird on the Body: a cause of public lawsuits. Hook Earth with a yin baleful star: do not seek the woman; the Dark Tortoise added to Wealth: do not ask about the match.

zh: 白虎临财莫问婚，勾加官位克夫身。
杀临兄弟多争竞，朱雀临身公讼因。
勾陈阴杀休求女，玄武加财休问亲。
yi: 白虎临在财爻上，不要问婚事；勾陈加在官鬼位上，克夫身。
凶煞临在兄弟爻上，多有争执；朱雀临身（爻），因官司而起。
勾陈带阴煞，不要求女方；玄武加在财爻上，不要问亲事。
en: The White Tiger on the Wealth line: do not ask about the marriage; Hook Earth added to the Pressure position controls the husband's person.
A baleful star on a Peer line: many quarrels; the Vermilion Bird on the Body: a cause of public lawsuits.
Hook Earth with a yin baleful star: do not seek the woman; the Dark Tortoise added to Wealth: do not ask about the match.

units.title: 龙并子孙全吉兆，喜重父母福相邻；坤变坎宫男破体，乾来离位女非真

rule.yi: 青龙并上子孙爻，全是吉兆；喜上加喜的是父母爻也重叠，福气相邻。坤卦变到坎宫，男子身体受损（破体）；乾卦来到离位，女子不真（不是所表现的那样）。
rule.en: The Azure Dragon joined to the Output line is an entirely auspicious omen; joy doubled with the Resource line, fortune stands adjacent. Kun changing into the Kan palace: the man's body is broken; Qian coming to the Li position: the woman is not genuine.

zh: 龙并子孙全吉兆，喜重父母福相邻。
坤变坎宫男破体，乾来离位女非真。
yi: 青龙并上子孙爻，全是吉兆；喜上加喜的是父母爻也重叠，福气相邻。
坤卦变到坎宫，男子身体受损（破体）；乾卦来到离位，女子不真。
en: The Azure Dragon joined to the Output line is an entirely auspicious omen; joy doubled with the Resource line, fortune stands adjacent.
Kun changing into the Kan palace: the man's body is broken; Qian coming to the Li position: the woman is not genuine.

note.yi: 「男破体」「女非真」两句原文只有这几个字：「破体」可以是身体受损，也可以另有所指；「非真」是「不是所表现的那样」。译文按字面，没有替书补充。
note.en: The two phrases 'the man's body is broken' and 'the woman is not genuine' have only these words in the original: 'body broken' may mean bodily harm or something else, and 'not genuine' means 'not what she seems'. They are translated literally without adding to the book.

units.title: 欲知女子如何性：坎聪艮静、兑柔巽恭、坤宽乾刚、离文明、震智慧；容貌：乾面大坤魁肥、艮小坎团圆、兑莹白、震端、巽如雪、离和润

rule.yi: 想知道女子是什么性情：坎卦主心思聪明，艮卦主沉静，兑卦温和柔顺，巽卦恭顺，坤爻宽厚，乾爻刚正；文雅明白的女子是因为遇到离卦，有智慧的男子是因为见到震卦。看容貌：乾宫面部又大又宽，坤主魁梧肥胖，艮卦身体小，坎爻脸团圆，兑家的女子晶莹白净，震位的妻子儿女奇特而端正，巽体的容颜像瑞雪，离宫温和润泽、好看。
rule.en: To know a woman's nature: Kan means a clever mind, Gen calm and stillness, Dui gentleness, Xun respect, a Kun line generosity and kindness, a Qian line firmness and uprightness; a cultured and bright woman is so because she meets Li, and a wise man because he sees Zhen. For looks: the Qian palace has a face large and broad, Kun a big, stout build, Gen a small body, a Kan line a round face; a woman of the Dui house is lustrous and fair, a wife or child of the Zhen position striking and upright, Xun's complexion is like auspicious snow, and the Li palace is mild, moist and pleasing to look at.

zh: 欲知女子如何性，坎主心聪艮沉静。
兑必和柔巽必恭，坤爻宽厚乾刚正。
文明女子为逢离，智慧男儿因见震。
乾宫面部大而宽，坤主魁肥莫小看。
艮卦决然身体小，坎爻定是脸团圆。
兑家女子莹而白，震位妻儿奇且端。
巽体容颜如瑞雪，离宫和润可人观。
yi: 想知道女子是什么性情：坎卦主心思聪明，艮卦主沉静。
兑卦一定温和柔顺，巽卦一定恭顺，坤爻宽厚，乾爻刚正。
文雅明白的女子是因为遇到离卦，有智慧的男子是因为见到震卦。
乾宫的人面部又大又宽，坤主魁梧肥胖，不要小看。
艮卦一定身体小，坎爻一定是脸团圆。
兑家的女子晶莹白净，震位的妻子儿女奇特而端正。
巽体的容颜像瑞雪，离宫的温和润泽、好看。
en: To know what nature the woman has: Kan means a clever mind, Gen means calm and still.
Dui is surely gentle and soft, Xun surely respectful; a Kun line is generous and kind, a Qian line firm and upright.
A cultured and bright woman is so because she meets Li; a wise man is so because he sees Zhen.
The Qian palace has a face large and broad; Kun means a big, stout build, not to be underestimated.
Gen is surely small in body; a Kan line is surely round in face.
A woman of the Dui house is lustrous and fair; a wife or child of the Zhen position is striking and upright.
Xun's complexion is like auspicious snow; the Li palace is mild, moist and pleasing to look at.

note.yi: 这一段是按八卦断性情容貌的口诀。《周易尚占》「八卦断例章」、《文王金钱课》里按卦名断事的句子，库里没有收（那是「某卦主某事」的口诀）；这里收，是因为它属于《火珠林》婚姻章本身，而且讲的是「对方是什么人」这一个问题。
note.en: This passage judges nature and looks by the eight trigrams. The lines that judge matters by hexagram name in the Zhouyi Shangzhan's chapter on the eight trigrams and in the Wenwang Jinqian Ke are not included in this library (they are 'this hexagram means that' rhymes); this one is included because it belongs to the Huozhulin's marriage chapter itself and answers one question, what the other party is like.

units.title: 有亡有劫都无用，无子无财总不堪

rule.yi: 卦里有亡神、劫煞，都没有用；没有子孙爻、没有财爻，总是不堪。
rule.en: With the Loss star or the Robbery star present, all is useless; without an Output line and without Wealth, it is altogether unbearable.

zh: 有亡有劫都无用，无子无财总不堪。
yi: 有亡神、有劫煞，都没有用；没有子孙爻、没有财爻，总是不堪。
en: With the Loss star or the Robbery star present, all is useless; without an Output line and without Wealth, it is altogether unbearable.

units.title: 阴阳得位俱称吉，纯阴枉使心和力，纯阳退悔不成婚，纵使强成终郁郁

rule.yi: 阴阳各得其位，都称吉利；全是阴的，白白费心费力；全是阳的，有退悔，成不了婚；即使勉强成了，终究郁闷不乐。
rule.en: Yin and yang each in its place: all is called auspicious; all yin: heart and strength spent in vain; all yang: regret and withdrawal, and the marriage is not made; even if forced through, it ends in gloom.

zh: 阴阳得位俱称吉，
纯阴枉使心和力，纯阳退悔不成婚，
纵使强成终郁郁。
yi: 阴阳各得其位，都称吉利；
全是阴的，白白费心费力；全是阳的，有退悔，成不了婚；
即使勉强成了，终究郁闷不乐。
en: Yin and yang each in its place: all is called auspicious;
all yin: heart and strength spent in vain; all yang: regret and withdrawal, and the marriage is not made;
even if forced through, it ends in gloom.

units.title: 金爻主妻好容光，木爻瘦小修长，土主肥矮，火爻发稀黄，水爻聪慧；六合发动最为昌

rule.yi: 金爻，主妻子容光好；木爻，瘦小而修长；土，主身形又胖又矮；火爻，一定是头发稀疏发黄；水爻，心性多聪明；六合发动，最为昌盛。
rule.en: A Metal line: the wife has a fine, radiant look; a Wood line: slim, small and slender; Earth: a body stout and short; a Fire line: thin, yellowish hair; a Water line: a mind mostly clever; a Six-combine moving is the most prosperous.

zh: 金爻主妻好容光，木爻瘦小更修长。
土主形骸肥且矮，火爻定是发稀黄。
水爻心性多聪慧，六合发动最为昌。
yi: 金爻，主妻子容光好；木爻，瘦小而修长。
土，主身形又胖又矮；火爻，一定是头发稀疏发黄。
水爻，心性多聪明；六合发动，最为昌盛。
en: A Metal line: the wife has a fine, radiant look; a Wood line: slim, small and slender.
Earth: a body stout and short; a Fire line: surely thin, yellowish hair.
A Water line: a mind mostly clever; a Six-combine moving is the most prosperous.

note.yi: 原文只说「金爻」「木爻」……没有说是哪一个爻的五行，按上下文多半是财爻；译文照字面，没有添补。
note.en: The text says only 'a Metal line', 'a Wood line' and so on without saying whose element is meant; from the context it is most likely the Wealth line. It is translated literally without adding to it.

units.title: 青龙旺相临财位，娶妻万倍有资妆

rule.yi: 青龙旺相，临在财爻的位置，娶妻有万倍的资财妆奁。
rule.en: The Azure Dragon strong and on the Wealth position: marrying a wife brings a dowry and funds many times over.

zh: 青龙旺相临财位，娶妻万倍有资妆。
yi: 青龙旺相，临在财爻的位置，娶妻有万倍的资财妆奁。
en: The Azure Dragon strong and on the Wealth position: marrying a wife brings a dowry and funds many times over.

units.title: 若逢天寡天鳏杀，夫妇应知不久长

rule.yi: 如果遇到天寡煞、天鳏煞，要知道夫妻不会长久。
rule.en: If one meets the Heavenly Widow or Heavenly Widower baleful star, know that the couple will not last long.

zh: 若逢天寡天鳏杀，夫妇应知不久长。
yi: 如果遇到天寡煞、天鳏煞，要知道夫妻不会长久。
en: If one meets the Heavenly Widow or Heavenly Widower baleful star, know that the couple will not last long.

units.title: 凡人占卦问婚姻，财鬼双全便可成；鬼是夫爻愁子动，财为妻也怕兄兴

rule.yi: 凡是占卦问婚姻，财爻、鬼爻两样齐全就可以成。鬼爻是丈夫，愁的是子孙爻动；财爻是妻子，也怕兄弟爻旺。
rule.en: Whenever someone divines a marriage, with both Wealth and Pressure complete it can be made. The Pressure line is the husband, and he fears a moving Output line; the Wealth line is the wife, and she fears a flourishing Peer line.

zh: 凡人占卦问婚姻，财鬼双全便可成。
鬼是夫爻愁子动，财为妻也怕兄兴。
yi: 凡是人占卦问婚姻，财爻、鬼爻两样齐全就可以成。
鬼爻是丈夫，愁的是子孙爻动；财爻是妻子，也怕兄弟爻旺。
en: Whenever someone divines a marriage: with both Wealth and Pressure complete, it can be made.
The Pressure line is the husband, and he fears a moving Output line; the Wealth line is the wife, and she fears a flourishing Peer line.

units.title: 鬼爻持动女妨害，妇意嫌夫不相爱；财爻持动夫妨妻，终身不泰

rule.yi: 鬼爻持世而动，对女方有妨害，妻子心里嫌丈夫，夫妻不相爱；财爻持世而动，丈夫妨碍妻子，这样一辈子都不会安泰。
rule.en: A Pressure line that holds the Self and moves harms the woman: the wife dislikes her husband and they do not love each other; a Wealth line that holds the Self and moves means the husband hinders the wife, and all their life will not be at peace.

zh: 鬼爻持动女妨害，妇意嫌夫不相爱。
财爻持动夫妨妻，此则终身应不泰。
yi: 鬼爻持世而动，对女方有妨害，妻子心里嫌丈夫，不相爱。
财爻持世而动，丈夫妨碍妻子，这样一辈子都不会安泰。
en: A Pressure line that holds the Self and moves harms the woman: the wife dislikes her husband and they do not love each other.
A Wealth line that holds the Self and moves: the husband hinders the wife, and all their life will not be at peace.

note.yi: 「鬼爻持动」「财爻持动」的「持」，原文没有写持什么；这里按婚姻章一路的用法读作「持世」。
note.en: The text does not say what the line 'holds' in 'a Pressure line that holds and moves'; it is read as 'holds the Self line', as elsewhere in the marriage chapters.

units.title: 鬼旺克财妻不就，子旺伤夫事可疑；八纯动者生离别，五世游魂损小儿

rule.yi: 鬼爻旺而克财爻，妻子娶不成；子孙爻旺而伤丈夫，这事可疑。八纯卦动的，主生离别；五世卦、游魂卦，损伤小孩。
rule.en: A strong Pressure line controlling Wealth: the wife cannot be got; a strong Output line harming the husband: the matter is doubtful. A pure eight-palace hexagram that moves means parting alive; a fifth-generation or Wandering Soul hexagram harms the children.

zh: 鬼旺克财妻不就，子旺伤夫事可疑。
八纯动者生离别，五世游魂损小儿。
yi: 鬼爻旺而克财爻，妻子娶不成；子孙爻旺而伤丈夫，这事可疑。
八纯卦动的，生离别；五世卦、游魂卦，损伤小孩。
en: A strong Pressure line controlling Wealth: the wife cannot be got; a strong Output line harming the husband: the matter is doubtful.
A pure eight-palace hexagram that moves means parting alive; a fifth-generation or Wandering Soul hexagram harms the children.

units.title: 占婚本要阴与阳，动时皆动且为良；阳阳不动一财鬼，应阴世阳最吉祥；世爻居内卦，团圆男女百年昌

rule.yi: 占婚原本要阴阳相配；动的时候一起动也算好。阳爻都不动，只有一个财爻、一个鬼爻，应爻是阴、世爻是阳，最吉祥。再得世爻在内卦，男女团圆，百年昌盛。
rule.en: A marriage divination needs yin with yang; when they move, moving together is also good. If the yang lines do not move and there is just one Wealth and one Pressure, with the Other line yin and the Self line yang, it is the most auspicious. Better still if the Self line sits in the inner trigram: man and woman are reunited and prosper for a hundred years.

zh: 占婚本要阴与阳，动时皆动且为良。
阳阳不动一财鬼，应阴世阳最吉祥。
更得世爻居内卦、团圆男女百年昌。
yi: 占婚原本要阴阳相配；动的时候，一起动也算好。
阳爻都不动，只有一个财爻、一个鬼爻，应爻是阴、世爻是阳，最吉祥。
再得世爻在内卦，男女团圆，百年昌盛。
en: For a marriage divination one needs yin with yang; when they move, moving together is also good.
If the yang lines do not move and there is just one Wealth and one Pressure, with the Other line yin and the Self line yang, it is the most auspicious.
Better still if the Self line sits in the inner trigram: man and woman are reunited and prosper for a hundred years.

note.yi: 「阳阳不动一财鬼」一句语法不清，可读作「阳爻都不动，只有一财一鬼」；译文取这个读法。
note.en: The phrase 'yang yang do not move, one Wealth and Pressure' is unclear in grammar; it is read as 'the yang lines do not move, and there is only one Wealth and one Pressure'.

units.title: 本宫无气财有气，妇舍虽贫女容媚；本宫旺相财囚死，妇舍虽贫女不美

rule.yi: 本宫没有气、财爻有气，女方家里虽然贫寒，女子容貌娇媚；本宫旺相、财爻囚死，女方家里虽然贫寒，女子也不漂亮。
rule.en: If the home palace lacks vigor but Wealth has vigor, although the woman's family is poor, the girl is charming; if the home palace is strong but Wealth is imprisoned or dead, the woman's family is poor and the girl is not beautiful.

zh: 本宫无气财有气，妇舍虽贫女容媚。
本宫旺相财囚死，妇舍虽贫女不美。
yi: 本宫没有气，财爻有气，女方家里虽然贫寒，女子容貌娇媚。
本宫旺相，财爻囚、死，女方家里虽然贫寒，女子也不漂亮。
en: The home palace lacks vigor but Wealth has vigor: although the woman's family is poor, the girl is charming.
The home palace strong but Wealth imprisoned or dead: the woman's family is poor and the girl is not beautiful.
